title: Immunofluorescence Staining of Heparan Sulfate in Islet Beta Cells
author: Sarah Popp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kvycw7w
materials: goat anti mouse IgM AF488 (Thermo Fisher #A21042)

Apply secondary antibodies for anti-insulin or anti-glucagon pAb: (a) For insulin staining, apply goat anti-guinea pig IgG AF568 (Thermo Fisher #A11075), 10 μg/ml dilution in 2% BSA/PBS, 125 μl/section, and incubate for 30 min at room temperature. (b) For glucagon staining, apply donkey anti-rabbit IgG AF568 (Thermo Fisher #A10042), 4 μg/ml in 2% BSA/PBS , 125 μl/section, and incubate for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and rehydrate slides
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize slides in xylene for 1 min, then rehydrate through graded alcohols: dip 10 times in absolute ethanol, 10 times in 90 % ethanol, and 10 times in 70 % ethanol; finally wash in running tap water for 5 min.

steps.title: Encircle sections and place in water
steps.instruction: Wipe around each tissue section with a clean tissue, encircle the section with a diamond pencil, and transfer the slide to a container holding 250 ml of tap water.

steps.title: Prewarm humidified slide tray
steps.instruction: Place a slide tray containing a low level of water in a 37 °C incubator to humidify it.

steps.title: Prepare pronase solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2.5 mg pronase (Calbiochem #537088) in 5 ml de‑ionized water to make the antigen‑retrieval solution.

steps.title: Pronase antigen retrieval
steps.instruction: Cover each section with the pronase solution, return the humidified tray to the 37 °C incubator, and incubate for 10 min.

steps.title: PBS wash series (post‑pronase)
steps.instruction: Wash sections in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) as follows: three quick washes, then three washes of 5 min each in a slide container with 250 ml PBS, agitating the slides at 0, 2, and 5 min of each wash.

steps.title: Block with BSA
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in 2 % bovine serum albumin (BSA) in PBS at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: PBS wash series (post‑block)
steps.instruction: Repeat the PBS wash series: three quick washes followed by three 5‑min washes in 250 ml PBS with agitation at 0, 2, and 5 min.

steps.title: Primary anti‑HS antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Apply 10E4 anti‑heparan sulfate monoclonal antibody at 100 µg/ml in 2 % BSA/PBS (125 µl per section) and incubate overnight at 4 °C in a humidified tray containing PBS.

steps.title: PBS wash series (post‑primary)
steps.instruction: Perform the PBS wash series again: three quick washes then three 5‑min washes in 250 ml PBS with agitation at 0, 2, and 5 min.

steps.title: Secondary anti‑mouse IgM incubation
steps.instruction: Apply goat anti‑mouse IgM Alexa Fluor 488 (Thermo Fisher #A21042) at 20 µg/ml in 2 % BSA/PBS (125 µl per section) and incubate 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: PBS wash series (post‑secondary)
steps.instruction: Repeat the PBS wash series as above (three quick washes, three 5‑min washes, 250 ml PBS, agitation at 0, 2, 5 min).

steps.title: Apply insulin or glucagon antibody
steps.instruction: For insulin staining: add polyclonal guinea‑pig anti‑insulin (DAKO #A0564) at 130 µg/ml in 2 % BSA/PBS (125 µl/section) and incubate 30 min at room temperature. For glucagon staining: add rabbit polyclonal anti‑glucagon (Abcam #ab133195) at 10 µg/ml in 2 % BSA/PBS (125 µl/section) and incubate 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: PBS wash series (post‑hormone)
steps.instruction: Perform the PBS wash series again (three quick washes, three 5‑min washes in 250 ml PBS with agitation at 0, 2, and 5 min).

steps.title: DAPI nuclear staining
steps.instruction: Stain sections with DAPI (Sigma #D9524) at 0.2 µg/ml in PBS for 2 min.

steps.title: Final PBS washes
steps.instruction: Wash sections with PBS three times, then a final 5‑min wash in 250 ml PBS with agitation at 0, 2.5, and 5 min (10 × agitation cycles).

steps.title: Mount with antifade medium
steps.instruction: Mount slides using ProLong® Diamond Antifade Mountant (Thermo Fisher #P36961).

steps.title: Acquire fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Image sections on an automated Axio Observer inverted fluorescence microscope (Zeiss) and generate merged images using ZEN software version 2.3 (Zeiss).
